system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Been using <USER> for a month. Holy crap its waaaay better than other paid services. Please come to India, I'd love to pay for your services."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! We're thrilled to hear you're loving Spotify! We're always looking to expand, so keep an eye out for updates. Have a great day! 🙂"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Spotify is already available in India; reply should clarify this to avoid confusion."}
